name: University College London
description: University College London is a public research university in London founded in 1826, the first university institution in England to admit students regardless of religion and the first to admit women on equal terms. It is a constituent college of the University of London and teaches across medicine, engineering, law, the sciences and the arts.
whyIncluded: UCL's Singapore page reports around 600 students from Singapore and more than 4,000 Singaporean alumni, with one of the largest Singapore societies in the UK; it is also on both the Singapore Medical Council and the Singapore Institute of Legal Education recognition lists.

livingCosts.summary: UCL's own 2026/27 estimate for an undergraduate in UCL self-catered halls over a 39-week year: rent, food, a zones 1-2 Travelcard, phone, course materials and wellbeing. Excludes flights, visa and health surcharge.
livingCosts.notes: Rung A. UCL 'How much does it cost to study at UCL?' page (read 2026-10-13). Undergraduate, UCL self-catered halls, based on 2026/27 UCL accommodation figures: average rent GBP 320/week, GBP 12,480 per 39-week academic year (range GBP 153.86 to over 455.71/week). 'Other essential costs' (Save the Student 2025 survey uprated by 10%), per 39-week year: food 2,067; course materials 234; mobile phone 234; health and wellbeing 234; Travelcard zones 1-2 1,216 (total 3,985). Divided by 9 months: housing 12,480; food 2,067; transport 1,216; personal = 234 x 3 = 702. Shared private rent on the same page: GBP 150-300/week excluding bills. Replaces the earlier US-loan cost-of-attendance budget read from an archive copy.

programmes.name: Medicine MBBS BSc
programmes.feeBasis: UCL's 2027/28 overseas Medicine schedule: £40,800 a year for the 2 pre-clinical years and the BSc year, then £72,134 for each of the 3 clinical years.
programmes.summary: Six years at your intake's published schedule (2027 entry): £40,800 for each of 2 pre-clinical years and the intercalated BSc year, then £72,134 for each of 3 clinical years, about £338,800 in all. UCL may add inflation yearly.
programmes.notes: Overseas fee for 2027/28 entrants (UK £10,050) from UCL's official undergraduate fee schedule (the table embedded in ucl.ac.uk/study/student-finances/tuition-fees/fee-schedules/fee-schedules-2027-2028/undergraduate-fees-2027-2028). The programme lasts six academic years but UCL bills overseas students in five annual instalments of £59,600 (an averaged rate: 2 x £40,800 pre-clinical plus 3 x £72,134 clinical), which is why the record once had durationYears 5 (the number of fee years); since 2026-10-14 durationYears is 6 so the intercalated BSc year is priced too, see below. The schedule states that Overseas Medicine fees are excluded from the cohort guarantee and are subject to annual increases of no more than RPI-X (see the 2026-10-14 note below on why cohortLocked is nevertheless true). The 2026 entry was read on the 2026 Medicine MBBS BSc prospectus page through a reader proxy (r.jina.ai) on 2026-09-30 and matches the 2026/27 schedule. No separate compulsory fees; additional costs (DBS check, equipment, placement travel) excluded. 2024/2025 rows from UCL's official undergraduate fee schedule tool for those years (same source as the current record, year=2024 and year=2025, fetched directly 2026-10-05), row 'Medicine: Medicine, MB,BS (UBMMEDSING01)': 2024 Overseas full-time £50,300, note 'Overseas students pay the fees in 5 annual instalments of £50,300 (2x £34,400 plus 3x £60,900), subject to annual increases of no more than RPI-X'; 2025 Overseas £53,400, '5 annual instalments of £53,400 (2x £36,500 plus 3x £64,667)'. Same five-instalment averaged rate as the current record. Later-year check 2026-10-08: year-1 fee changed from the averaged £59,600 to the pre-clinical rate £40,800 with laterYears from fee-year 3 at the clinical rate £72,134 (2 x 40,800 + 3 x 72,134 = £298,002, matching the averaged total). The 2026/27 prospectus page confirms the same pattern (5 instalments of £57,300 = 2 x £39,200 + 3 x £69,367); the 2027/28 split is the 2026-10-01 reading of the fee-schedule tool (could not be re-read because the tool page truncates before Medical Sciences). The intercalated BSc (year 3 of 6) is not one of the five MBBS instalments and UCL publishes no fee for it. feeHistory rows record the year-1 pre-clinical instalment of each year (2026: 39,200 of 2 x 39,200 + 3 x 69,367; 2025: 36,500 of 36,500 / 64,667; 2024: 34,400 of 34,400 / 60,900), and since the bug fix of 2026-10-14 each row also carries its own cohort's clinical rate as laterYears (2026: £69,367; 2025: £64,667; 2024: £60,900) with cohortLocked true, so every intake is priced at its own published five-instalment schedule (2026: 2 x 39,200 + 3 x 69,367 = £286,501; 2025: £267,001; 2024: £251,500) instead of the 2027 clinical rate. UCL's schedule says overseas Medicine fees are outside the cohort guarantee and may rise by up to RPI-X a year; that possible rise is not modelled, so cohortLocked here means 'priced at the intake's published schedule', as stated in the summary. Second look 2026-10-14: the record charged only the five MBBS instalments (durationYears 5), leaving the intercalated BSc year (year 3 of 6) unpriced. UCL's undergraduate fee schedule tool (https://www.ucl.ac.uk/digital-presence-services/degree-fees-drupal/index.php?coursetype=undergraduate&year=2027, read 2026-10-14) lists the UCL Medical School iBSc programmes (UBIMDS0001-1718, e.g. 'Mathematics, Computers and Medicine, iBSc') at Overseas £40,800 for 2027/28, the same as the MBBS pre-clinical instalment, and the 2024-2026 tools list the 'Medicine: ... BSc (Intercal) (UBMMEDSING01)' rows at £34,400 / £36,500 / £39,200, again equal to that year's pre-clinical rate. durationYears is now 6 and laterYears charge year 3 at the iBSc rate and years 4-6 at the clinical rate (current record 40,800 / 72,134; 2026 row 39,200 / 69,367; 2025 row 36,500 / 64,667; 2024 row 34,400 / 60,900), so the six-year international total is 2027 entry 3 x 40,800 + 3 x 72,134 = £338,802; 2026 entry 3 x 39,200 + 3 x 69,367 = £325,701; 2025 £303,501; 2024 £285,900. The iBSc fee used for each cohort is the one published for its entry year; UCL publishes the iBSc rate per academic year and may raise it (RPI-X) by the time the cohort reaches year 3. Fix 2026-10-15: the notes sentence that still said 'durationYears 5 reflects the number of fee years' was reworded to match durationYears 6. Source: https://www.ucl.ac.uk/digital-presence-services/degree-fees-drupal/index.php?coursetype=undergraduate&year=2027.
